siemens-sgt-100-for-sale.intro: The SGT-100 is the smallest gas turbine in the Siemens Energy industrial range. It goes back to the Ruston Typhoon design and is built as a compact package for sites that need a few megawatts of power and heat.
uses: Combined heat and power for factories, hospitals and district heating
Power for oil and gas platforms and production sites
Island operation where no grid is available
siemens-sgt-100-for-sale.diff: Compared with the SGT-300 and SGT-400 the SGT-100 is the choice for small loads. Buyers who need more output per unit usually move up to the SGT-300; buyers who compare across brands often look at the Solar Centaur 40 in the same small output class.
checks: Package scope: enclosure, generator, gearbox, control system and auxiliaries included or not
Combustion system: conventional or DLE low emission, which decides the emission values at the new site
Overhaul history of the gas generator and the documents of the last inspection
faq: What was the SGT-100 called before?
The SGT-100 goes back to the Ruston Typhoon gas turbine. Siemens took over the range and renamed it SGT-100.
Is the SGT-100 suitable for combined heat and power?
Yes. The exhaust heat of the SGT-100 is commonly used in a heat recovery boiler for steam or hot water, which is a main reason why the model is used in industry and district heating.

siemens-sgt-300-for-sale.intro: The SGT-300 is a Siemens Energy industrial gas turbine in the small output class. It goes back to the Tempest design and is used both for power generation and, in its twin shaft version, for driving compressors.
uses: Power generation on oil and gas sites, on and offshore
Simple cycle power for remote sites
siemens-sgt-300-for-sale.diff: The SGT-300 sits between the SGT-100 and the SGT-400. It is chosen when the SGT-100 is too small and the site load does not justify an SGT-400.
checks: Single shaft version (generator drive) or twin shaft version (mainly mechanical drive)
Preservation records if the unit is unused or stored
DLE combustion configuration and the fuel the unit was set up for
faq: What was the SGT-300 called before?
The SGT-300 goes back to the Tempest gas turbine from the former Ruston and Alstom industrial range, now part of Siemens Energy.
What is the difference between the SGT-300 and the SGT-400?
Both are Siemens Energy industrial gas turbines. The SGT-400 has the higher output; the SGT-300 suits smaller loads. See the comparison page SGT-400 vs SGT-300 for the manufacturer data side by side.

siemens-sgt-400-for-sale.intro: The SGT-400 is a Siemens Energy industrial gas turbine in the lower medium output class. It goes back to the Cyclone design and is widely used offshore and in industrial cogeneration.
uses: Offshore platforms and FPSO power generation
Combined cycle for small power plants
siemens-sgt-400-for-sale.diff: The SGT-400 is the step above the SGT-300 and below the SGT-600. It is offered in two output versions, so the exact rating of a used unit should always be checked on the data sheet.
checks: Which output version the unit is
DLE combustion and the emission values guaranteed by the original supplier
Offshore or onshore package design, since offshore skids and enclosures differ
faq: What was the SGT-400 called before?
The SGT-400 goes back to the Cyclone gas turbine from the former Alstom industrial range, now part of Siemens Energy.
Is the SGT-400 used offshore?
Yes. The manufacturer lists offshore platforms and FPSO among the typical applications of the SGT-400.

siemens-sgt-600-for-sale.intro: The SGT-600 is a Siemens Energy industrial gas turbine in the medium output class. It goes back to the ABB GT10B and is still often searched under that name.
uses: Heating applications with heat recovery boilers
siemens-sgt-600-for-sale.diff: The SGT-600 sits below the SGT-700, which was developed from the GT10C of the same family. Buyers who need more output per unit with the same family background usually compare it with the SGT-700.
checks: Whether the unit is a GT10B, GT10B1 or later SGT-600 version
Hours and starts since the last major overhaul
Scope of the heat recovery steam generator if one is included
faq: Is the SGT-600 the same as the GT10B?
Yes. The SGT-600 goes back to the ABB GT10B. Units are traded under both names, and older units are often still listed as GT10B.
Can an SGT-600 be used in combined cycle?
Yes. Simple cycle, combined cycle and cogeneration are listed by the manufacturer as typical applications.

siemens-sgt-700-for-sale.intro: The SGT-700 is a Siemens Energy industrial gas turbine in the medium output class. It was developed from the GT10C and is used for power generation, cogeneration and mechanical drive.
uses: Combined cycle blocks with heat recovery steam generator
Oil and gas power and compressor drive
siemens-sgt-700-for-sale.diff: The SGT-700 sits between the SGT-600 and the SGT-800. Compared with aeroderivatives in a similar output class, such as the GE LM2500, it is an industrial design with longer intervals between overhauls but heavier packages.
checks: Complete train scope: gas turbine, generator, HRSG and steam turbine if sold as a block
Fuel system: gas only or dual fuel
Status of the warranty or OEM service agreement if the unit is new
faq: What was the SGT-700 called before?
The SGT-700 goes back to the GT10C gas turbine, developed from the GT10B family.
What is the difference between the SGT-700 and the SGT-800?
Both are Siemens Energy industrial gas turbines. The SGT-800 has the higher output. See the comparison page SGT-800 vs SGT-700 for manufacturer data side by side.

siemens-sgt-800-for-sale.intro: The SGT-800 is a Siemens Energy industrial gas turbine at the top of the industrial output range. It goes back to the GTX100 and is often installed in combined cycle and cogeneration plants.
siemens-sgt-800-for-sale.diff: The SGT-800 is the largest industrial gas turbine in the Siemens Energy range; above it start the heavy duty utility gas turbines such as the SGT5-2000E. Several ratings exist, so the rating of a used unit matters for the comparison.
checks: Rating of the unit and the year of the upgrade if any
Whether a steam turbine and HRSG come with the gas turbine
Hours, starts and the date of the last combustion and hot gas path inspection
faq: What was the SGT-800 called before?
The SGT-800 goes back to the GTX100 gas turbine developed by ABB and later Alstom, now part of Siemens Energy.
Is the SGT-800 used in combined cycle?
Yes. Combined cycle and cogeneration are main applications. Several units listed on lks360.com are combined cycle blocks with gas turbine and steam turbine.
What does a Siemens SGT-800 cost?

LKS 360-SCHREINER LLC quotes the price of each listed SGT-800 on request with the stock number. It depends on rating, hours and starts, overhaul records, condition, scope, combined cycle equipment, frequency and location.
siemens-sgt-800-for-sale.seo_title: Siemens SGT-800 for Sale: New and Used Gas Turbines | LKS 360

price.title: Siemens SGT-800 price: what sets it
price.intro: LKS 360-SCHREINER LLC does not publish prices; each Siemens SGT-800 is priced by its owner and quoted on request with the stock number. The price depends on these points:
factors: Rating
The SGT-800 has been sold in several ratings; the rating of the unit decides the output and the comparison.
Hours and cycles since the last overhaul
Engine hours, starts and the date and scope of the last overhaul matter more than the year of manufacture.
Overhaul records
An engine back from the manufacturer or an authorised shop with full records sells faster than one without documents.
Condition
New and unused, zero time since overhaul, in operation or preserved: each condition is priced differently.
Scope of supply
Generator, enclosure, controls, fuel system, step up transformer and spare parts included or not.
Combined cycle scope
Whether a steam turbine, HRSG and balance of plant come with the gas turbine.
Frequency and voltage
A 60 Hz unit for the Americas and a 50 Hz unit for Europe, Africa or Asia are separate markets; dual frequency units widen the buyer group.
Emission system
DLE or water injected combustion decides whether a unit meets the emission limits at the buyer's site.
Location and logistics
Dismantling, transport, road permits and import duties are part of the buyer's total cost.

variants.title: Siemens SGT-800 ratings and configurations
variants.intro: Siemens Energy states ratings from 45 to 62 MW in simple cycle, for 50 Hz and 60 Hz, with DLE combustion capable of up to 75 vol% hydrogen.
rows: Simple cycle
Gas turbine generator set for industrial power.
Combined cycle and cogeneration
Gas turbine with HRSG and steam turbine; several units on lks360.com are combined cycle blocks.

siemens-sgt-750-for-sale.intro: The SGT-750 is a newer Siemens Energy industrial gas turbine in the medium output class, designed for power generation as well as mechanical drive in oil and gas.
uses: Compressor drive for pipelines and LNG
siemens-sgt-750-for-sale.diff: The SGT-750 sits in output between the SGT-700 and the SGT-800. It is a later design than both, so fewer used units reach the market.
checks: Generator drive or mechanical drive configuration
OEM service agreement status and transferability
Commissioning date and operating hours
faq: Are used SGT-750 units available?
Used SGT-750 units come to the market rarely because the model is comparatively new. We search the market on request and report what owners offer.

siemens-sgt5-2000e-for-sale.intro: The SGT5-2000E is a Siemens Energy heavy duty gas turbine for 50 Hz grids. It goes back to the V94.2 and is one of the established E class turbines in utility power plants.
uses: Simple cycle peaking and base load plants
siemens-sgt5-2000e-for-sale.diff: The SGT5-2000E is the 50 Hz version; the 60 Hz counterpart is the SGT6-2000E. In the E class it is usually compared with the GE Frame 9E.
checks: Combustor type and emission values
Major inspection history in equivalent operating hours
Scope of the plant: generator, step up transformer, HRSG and steam turbine
faq: Is the SGT5-2000E the same as the V94.2?
The SGT5-2000E goes back to the Siemens V94.2. Older units are still listed under the V94.2 name.
Which gas turbine is comparable to the SGT5-2000E?
In the 50 Hz E class the GE Frame 9E is the usual comparison.

siemens-westinghouse-w701-w501-for-sale.intro: W701 and W501 are heavy duty gas turbines from the Westinghouse fleet, which came to Siemens with the takeover of Westinghouse Power Generation. The W701 series runs on 50 Hz grids, the W501 series on 60 Hz grids.
uses: Utility simple cycle and combined cycle plants
Base load power with dual fuel capability
Plant relocations to regions that need large blocks of power quickly
siemens-westinghouse-w701-w501-for-sale.diff: The frequency decides the series: W701 for 50 Hz and W501 for 60 Hz. Within each series the letter after the number marks the generation, for example D5 or DS.
checks: Exact series and generation, for example W701DS or W501D5
Rebuild or overhaul reports and who carried them out
Balance of plant included in the sale
faq: What is the difference between the W701 and the W501?
The W701 series is built for 50 Hz grids and the W501 series for 60 Hz grids. Both come from the Westinghouse heavy duty fleet.
Who services W701 and W501 gas turbines today?
Siemens Energy and independent service providers support the fleet. The service history of the specific unit is part of the documents released after a letter of intent.

ge-frame-5-for-sale.intro: The GE Frame 5 (MS5001) is a heavy duty gas turbine with one of the longest service histories in the industry. Many units still run in power plants, refineries and on power barges.
uses: Power barges and mobile power plants
ge-frame-5-for-sale.diff: The MS5001 is the single shaft version for generator drive; the MS5002 is the two shaft version for mechanical drive. The Frame 6B is the next larger GE heavy duty model.
checks: MS5001 model letter, for example N, P or R, which decides the rating
Control system type and whether it was upgraded
Hot gas path and major inspection records
faq: What is the difference between the MS5001 and the MS5002?
The MS5001 is a single shaft gas turbine used for generator drive. The MS5002 is a two shaft design used mainly for compressor and pump drive.
Are Frame 5 gas turbines still supported?
Yes. GE and independent service providers still supply parts and service for the Frame 5 fleet.

ge-frame-6b-for-sale.intro: The GE Frame 6B (MS6001B) is a heavy duty gas turbine known for reliability and fuel flexibility. It is common in industrial cogeneration and in refineries.
uses: Combined cycle plants in the lower utility range
ge-frame-6b-for-sale.diff: The Frame 6B sits between the Frame 5 and the 7EA and 9E. Its fuel flexibility, including liquid fuels, makes it a frequent choice for industrial sites.
checks: Model version, for example 6B or 6B.03, and the upgrades installed
Fuel system and combustor type
OEM or third party overhaul reports
faq: Is the Frame 6B the same as the MS6001B?
Yes. Frame 6B and MS6001B name the same GE heavy duty gas turbine. Upgraded versions are often marked 6B.03.
What fuels can a Frame 6B burn?
The Frame 6B is known for fuel flexibility. The fuel a specific unit can burn depends on its fuel system and combustors, which are listed in the unit documents.

ge-7ea-for-sale.intro: The GE 7EA is a heavy duty E class gas turbine for 60 Hz grids. It is a common choice for peaking and combined cycle plants in the Americas and other 60 Hz regions.
uses: Peaking and mid merit power plants
Dual fuel plants with liquid fuel backup
ge-7ea-for-sale.diff: The 7EA is the 60 Hz E class model; the Frame 9E is its 50 Hz counterpart. For larger output on 60 Hz grids buyers look at the F class 7FA.
checks: Gas only or dual fuel
Combustion system and emission values
Major inspection status in equivalent operating hours
faq: What is the difference between the 7EA and the 9E?
The 7EA runs on 60 Hz grids and the 9E on 50 Hz grids. See the comparison page Frame 9E vs 7EA for manufacturer data side by side.
Is a 7EA suitable for the USA?
Yes. The 7EA is a 60 Hz gas turbine and fits the US grid without frequency conversion.

ge-frame-9e-for-sale.intro: The GE Frame 9E (MS9001E, for example PG9171E) is a heavy duty E class gas turbine for 50 Hz grids. It has a large installed fleet and is known for burning a wide range of fuels.
uses: Utility simple cycle and combined cycle plants
Plants burning gas and liquid fuels
ge-frame-9e-for-sale.diff: The 9E is the 50 Hz counterpart of the 60 Hz 7EA. In the 50 Hz E class it is often compared with the Siemens SGT5-2000E. The 9HA is the much larger H class model.
checks: Model designation, for example PG9171E, and the upgrades installed
Fuel system: gas, liquid or dual fuel
Balance of plant included, such as generator, transformer and stack
faq: What does PG9171E mean?
PG9171E is a GE model designation of the Frame 9E package for generator drive.
What is the difference between the Frame 9E and the 7EA?
The 9E is built for 50 Hz grids and the 7EA for 60 Hz grids. See Frame 9E vs 7EA for the manufacturer data.

ge-7fa-for-sale.intro: The GE 7FA is a heavy duty F class gas turbine for 60 Hz grids. It is one of the most installed F class turbines in combined cycle plants.
ge-7fa-for-sale.diff: The 7FA is the larger, more efficient 60 Hz step above the E class 7EA. The H class 9HA is the 50 Hz flagship.
checks: Model version, for example 7FA.03 or 7FA.04, and the upgrades installed
Remaining life of the hot gas path parts
Contractual service agreement status
faq: Are used 7FA gas turbines available?
Used and surplus 7FA units come to the market from plant closures and upgrades. We search the market on request.

ge-9ha-for-sale.intro: The GE 9HA is a heavy duty H class gas turbine for 50 Hz grids and one of the largest air cooled gas turbines on the market. It is built for large combined cycle power plants.
uses: Base load power with high efficiency
New build plants that need a large block of power
ge-9ha-for-sale.diff: The 9HA is far larger than the E class 9E. It is offered in the versions 9HA.01 and 9HA.02 with different outputs.
checks: Version 9HA.01 or 9HA.02
Storage and preservation records if the unit is unused
Transfer of OEM warranty and service agreements
faq: What is the difference between the 9HA.01 and the 9HA.02?
Both are GE H class gas turbines for 50 Hz. The 9HA.02 is the larger version. The data sheet of the specific unit states which version is offered.
Can an unused 9HA be bought on the secondary market?
Yes, unused units become available when projects are cancelled or changed. Such units are offered by their owners and listed with stock number on lks360.com when available.

ge-lm2500-for-sale.intro: The GE LM2500 is an aeroderivative gas turbine developed from the CF6 aircraft engine. It is used in industrial power generation, on ships and in oil and gas.
ge-lm2500-for-sale.diff: The LM2500 family includes the base LM2500, the LM2500+ and the LM2500+G4 with higher output. The TM2500 is a trailer mounted package built around the LM2500. The LM6000 is the larger GE aeroderivative.
checks: Exact version: LM2500, LM2500+ or LM2500+G4, and the combustor type (SAC or DLE)
Engine records and the depot where the last overhaul was done
Package scope: enclosure, generator, controls, trailer if mobile
faq: What is the difference between the LM2500, LM2500+ and LM2500+G4?
They are versions of the same aeroderivative family. The LM2500+ and LM2500+G4 have higher output than the base LM2500. The data sheet of each unit states the exact version.
Can an LM2500 engine be exchanged?
Aeroderivative engines can be removed and exchanged as a whole, which shortens outages. Engine exchange and lease options depend on the depot and are clarified case by case.

ge-tm2500-for-sale.intro: The GE TM2500 is a trailer mounted gas turbine generator built around the LM2500 aeroderivative engine. It is designed to be moved by road and set up quickly where power is needed.
uses: Fast track power for industrial projects
ge-tm2500-for-sale.diff: The TM2500 uses the same engine family as the stationary LM2500 package but comes on trailers. Buyers choose it when mobility and short installation time matter more than a permanent foundation.
checks: Number of trailers and their road permits
Engine version and hours since overhaul
Auxiliary equipment for fast setup: fuel forwarding, step up transformer, controls
faq: What is the difference between the TM2500 and the LM2500?
The TM2500 is a mobile, trailer mounted package with an LM2500 family engine. The LM2500 is usually installed as a stationary package. See LM2500 vs TM2500 for the details.
How fast can a TM2500 be installed?
The TM2500 is designed for short installation times. The real time depends on site preparation, fuel supply and grid connection.
What does a used GE TM2500 cost?

LKS 360-SCHREINER LLC quotes the price of each listed TM2500 on request with the stock number. It depends on version, hours and cycles since overhaul, overhaul records, condition, trailers and scope, frequency and location.
What is the difference between the TM2500 and the TM2500+?

According to GE, the TM2500+ introduced in 2008 is packaged on a two-trailer system and delivers up to 34 MW, with a 30 percent increase in power from a footprint 75 percent smaller than its predecessor.
What does Gen 6 mean on a TM2500?
Gen 4, Gen 5 and Gen 6 are generation labels used in the market for TM2500 units. A buyer checks the stated generation against the engine and generator documents, which follow the letter of intent.
ge-tm2500-for-sale.seo_title: GE TM2500 for Sale: Used Mobile Gas Turbines, Price Factors | LKS 360

price.title: GE TM2500 price: what sets it
price.intro: LKS 360-SCHREINER LLC does not publish prices; each GE TM2500 is priced by its owner and quoted on request with the stock number. The price of a used TM2500 depends on these points:
factors: Generation or version
Later versions usually reach higher output and efficiency; the version stated by the owner is checked against the engine data plate and documents.
Hours and cycles since the last overhaul
Engine hours, starts and the date and scope of the last overhaul matter more than the year of manufacture.
Overhaul records
An engine back from the manufacturer or an authorised shop with full records sells faster than one without documents.
Condition
New and unused, zero time since overhaul, in operation or preserved: each condition is priced differently.
Scope of supply
Generator, enclosure, controls, fuel system, step up transformer and spare parts included or not.
Trailers and mobile equipment
Number and condition of trailers, road permits and the mobile balance of plant decide how fast the unit can move to a new site.
Frequency and voltage
A 60 Hz unit for the Americas and a 50 Hz unit for Europe, Africa or Asia are separate markets; dual frequency units widen the buyer group.
Emission system
DLE or water injected combustion decides whether a unit meets the emission limits at the buyer's site.
Location and logistics
Dismantling, transport, road permits and import duties are part of the buyer's total cost.

variants.title: GE TM2500 versions: TM2500, TM2500+ and Gen 4, 5, 6
variants.intro: The TM2500 has been built in several versions. The version of a used unit is taken from its documents, not from the listing title.
rows: The first mobile package built around the LM2500 aeroderivative gas turbine; replaced by the TM2500+.

Introduced by GE in 2008: packaged on a two-trailer system, up to 34 MW, with the LM2500 gas turbine and a Brush 170ER generator. GE stated a 30 percent increase in power from a footprint 75 percent smaller than its predecessor.
Gen 4, Gen 5, Gen 6

Generation labels used by owners and traders for TM2500 units. They are not used on the current GE Vernova product page, so the generation stated by the owner is checked against the engine and generator documents.
TM2500 DLE and SAC
Current GE Vernova range: 34.5 MW net (DLE) and 34.6 MW net (SAC) at 50 Hz, ISO conditions.

ge-lm6000-for-sale.intro: The GE LM6000 is a two shaft aeroderivative gas turbine developed from the CF6-80C2 aircraft engine. It is widely used for peaking, cogeneration and fast start power plants.
uses: Power barges and fast track plants
ge-lm6000-for-sale.diff: The LM6000 is larger than the LM2500 and the successor of the LM5000. Versions include PA, PC, PD and PF; SPRINT units use water spray intercooling for more output on hot days.
checks: Version PA, PC, PD or PF and whether SPRINT is installed
Combustor type: SAC, DLE or water injection
Engine records, hours and cycles since the last overhaul
faq: What does SPRINT mean on an LM6000?
SPRINT stands for spray intercooling. Water is sprayed into the compressor to cool the air, which raises output, mainly on hot days.
What is the difference between LM6000 PA, PC and PD?
They are generations of the LM6000. PC and PD versions came later than the PA and differ in output and combustion system. The data sheet of each unit states the version.
What does a used GE LM6000 cost?

LKS 360-SCHREINER LLC quotes the price of each listed LM6000 on request with the stock number. It depends on version, hours and cycles since overhaul, overhaul records, condition, scope, frequency, emission system and location.
Is the wiring harness included with a used LM6000?

Harnesses, sensors and control cabling belong to the engine and package scope. The scope list of each unit states what is included; LKS 360-SCHREINER LLC lists complete units and packages, not single spare parts.
What is the difference between LM6000 SAC and DLE?

SAC is the single annular combustor, which GE Vernova describes as water injected; DLE is dry low emissions combustion. GE Vernova offers the current LM6000 in both configurations, and the data sheet of a used unit states which one it has.
ge-lm6000-for-sale.seo_title: GE LM6000 for Sale: Used PA, PC, PD, PF Sprint Gas Turbines | LKS 360

variants.title: GE LM6000 versions: PA, PC, PD, PF, PG and SPRINT
variants.intro: The LM6000 has been built in several versions. The version, the combustor and whether SPRINT is installed are taken from the unit's data sheet.
rows: LM6000 PA, PC, PD
Earlier LM6000 versions. Output and combustion system differ between versions; the data sheet of each unit states the version and the combustor (SAC or DLE).
LM6000 PC Sprint
Current GE Vernova LM6000VELOX package: 51.1 MW net, 39.7 percent net efficiency (ISO, natural gas).
LM6000 PF+ Sprint
Current GE Vernova LM6000VELOX package: 56.9 MW net, 41.0 percent net efficiency (ISO, natural gas).
LM6000 PG and PH
Announced by GE in 2010: the PG with single annular combustor (SAC), the PH as its dry low emissions (DLE) equivalent.
SPRINT
Spray intercooling: water is sprayed into the compressor to cool the air, which raises output, mainly on hot days.
sources: GE press release, 7 October 2010 (LM6000-PG and PH)

ge-lm5000-for-sale.intro: The GE LM5000 is an aeroderivative gas turbine developed from the CF6-50 aircraft engine. It is the predecessor of the LM6000 and still runs in simple cycle and cogeneration plants.
uses: Plants that already run LM5000 units and need spares or extra capacity
ge-lm5000-for-sale.diff: The LM5000 was followed by the LM6000. Buyers often compare used LM5000 units with older LM6000 PA units in the same output range.
checks: Engine overhaul records and parts availability
Package condition and control system
Hours since the last hot section inspection
faq: Is the LM5000 still supported?
Parts and service for the LM5000 are available from GE and independent providers. Availability of specific parts should be checked before purchase.

solar-titan-for-sale.intro: Titan is the largest gas turbine family of Solar Turbines, a Caterpillar company. The Titan 130 and Titan 250 are used for power generation and for driving compressors in oil and gas.
uses: Gas compression on pipelines and production sites
solar-titan-for-sale.diff: The Titan 250 is larger than the Titan 130. Both are larger than the Solar Centaur, Mars and Taurus families. Many Titan units are built for mechanical drive, so the drive type matters when a buyer needs a generator set.
checks: Mechanical drive or generator set package
SoLoNOx low emission combustion and the emission values
Overhaul history and service by Solar or third parties
faq: What is the difference between the Titan 130 and the Titan 250?
Both belong to the Titan family of Solar Turbines. The Titan 250 has the higher output. The data sheet of each unit states the rating.
Can a mechanical drive Titan be used for power generation?
A mechanical drive package is built to drive a compressor. Conversion to generator drive needs a different package and is assessed case by case.

solar-centaur-40-for-sale.intro: The Centaur 40 is a small industrial gas turbine from Solar Turbines, a Caterpillar company, with one of the largest installed fleets in its class. It is used for power generation and for compressor and pump drive.
uses: Generator sets for oil and gas sites
solar-centaur-40-for-sale.diff: The Centaur 40 is the smaller sister of the Centaur 50 and sits below the Taurus and Titan families. Across brands it is compared with the Siemens SGT-100.
checks: Overhaul by Solar or third party and the date
Combustion system: conventional or SoLoNOx
Package scope including generator and controls
faq: Is the Centaur 40 a good choice for small power needs?
The Centaur 40 is widely used for small loads in industry and oil and gas, and parts and service are available worldwide. Whether it fits depends on the site load and the fuel.

mitsubishi-mf111-for-sale.intro: The MF111 is an industrial gas turbine from Mitsubishi Heavy Industries in the small to medium output class. It is mostly used for cogeneration with a heat recovery steam generator.
mitsubishi-mf111-for-sale.diff: The MF111 is a Mitsubishi industrial design; in the same output range buyers usually compare it with the Siemens SGT-400 and the Solar Titan family.
checks: Scope of the heat recovery steam generator
Overhaul records and parts supply through the manufacturer
Fuel and emission configuration
faq: Where is the MF111 used?
The MF111 is mainly used in industrial cogeneration, often together with a heat recovery steam generator that supplies process steam.

siemens-sst-400-for-sale.intro: The SST-400 is a Siemens Energy industrial steam turbine with a single casing. It is used as condensing or back pressure turbine, with or without steam extraction.
uses: Waste to energy and biomass plants
Steam turbine in combined cycle blocks
siemens-sst-400-for-sale.diff: The SST-400 is the larger of the two Siemens industrial steam turbines listed here; the SST-300 covers smaller outputs. Whether condensing or back pressure fits depends on whether the plant needs process steam.
checks: Condensing or back pressure design and the extraction points
Live steam pressure and temperature on the data sheet
Scope: generator, gearbox, condenser, lube oil system
faq: Is the SST-400 a condensing or back pressure turbine?
The SST-400 is built in both designs. The data sheet of each unit states which design it is. See condensing vs back pressure steam turbine for the difference.

siemens-sst-300-for-sale.intro: The SST-300 is a Siemens Energy industrial steam turbine with a single casing for small and medium outputs. It is used in industrial cogeneration, biomass and waste heat plants.
uses: Biomass and waste to energy plants
siemens-sst-300-for-sale.diff: The SST-300 covers smaller outputs than the SST-400. It is offered as condensing or back pressure turbine and often with a gearbox between turbine and generator.
checks: Steam conditions the turbine was designed for
Gearbox and generator included
Preservation records if new and unused
faq: Can a new and unused SST-300 be adapted to another plant?
The steam path is designed for given steam conditions. Whether a unit fits another plant depends on steam pressure, temperature and flow, which the buyer's engineer checks against the data sheet.
What is the output of a Siemens SST-300?

Siemens Energy states an output of up to 60 MW and a speed of up to 12,000 rpm for the SST-300 industrial steam turbine. The output of a given unit follows from its steam conditions and is shown on its data sheet.
What does a Siemens SST-300 cost?
LKS 360-SCHREINER LLC quotes the price of each listed SST-300 on request with the stock number. It depends on condition, steam conditions, type, scope, frequency, documents and location.

variants.title: Siemens SST-300 configurations
variants.intro: Siemens Energy states an output of up to 60 MW and a speed of up to 12,000 rpm for the SST-300. Each unit is built for given steam conditions:
rows: Condensing
Exhausts into a condenser for maximum power output.
Back pressure
Exhausts steam at a pressure a process can still use, for cogeneration.
Extraction
Takes process steam out at one or more stages.
Drive
Often with a gearbox between the turbine and the generator.

caterpillar-g20cm34-for-sale.intro: The Caterpillar G20CM34 is a medium speed gas engine with 20 cylinders from the MaK engine line of Caterpillar. It is used in gas fired power plants and as generator set for industrial power.
caterpillar-g20cm34-for-sale.diff: Compared with high speed gas engines such as the Jenbacher J620, the G20CM34 is a larger medium speed engine with higher output per unit. The Wärtsilä 34SG is a comparable medium speed gas engine.
checks: Gas quality the engine is set up for
Scope: alternator, radiators, controls, exhaust system
Hours since major overhaul if used
faq: What type of engine is the G20CM34?
The G20CM34 is a medium speed spark ignited gas engine with 20 cylinders from the MaK line of Caterpillar.

caterpillar-3516-for-sale.intro: The Caterpillar 3516 is a high speed engine with 16 cylinders in V arrangement. It is one of the most used engines for standby and prime power generator sets, in mining and in oil and gas.
uses: Standby power for data centres and hospitals
Prime power for mines and remote sites
caterpillar-3516-for-sale.diff: The 3516B and 3516C are generations of the same engine; the C version came later with updated emission and control systems. Across brands the MTU 16V4000 and the Cummins QSK60 and KTA50 are common comparisons.
checks: Engine version 3516B or 3516C and the rating (standby or prime)
Hours and the date of the last top end or major overhaul
Container or open skid, alternator make and controls
faq: What is the difference between the 3516B and the 3516C?
Both are Caterpillar 3516 engines with 16 cylinders. The 3516C is the later generation with updated emission and control systems.
Standby or prime rating: what is the difference?
A standby rating applies to emergency use with limited hours per year. A prime rating applies to continuous operation with variable load. The rating of each unit is stated on its data plate.

wartsila-34sg-for-sale.intro: The Wärtsilä 34SG is a medium speed lean burn gas engine built in several cylinder versions. It is used in gas engine power plants for base load and for flexible grid balancing.
uses: Combined heat and power for industry and cities
wartsila-34sg-for-sale.diff: The 34SG is larger per unit than high speed engines such as the Jenbacher J620. The 20V34SG is the largest cylinder version. The Caterpillar G20CM34 is a comparable medium speed gas engine.
checks: Cylinder version, for example 20V34SG
Gas quality and methane number the engine is set up for
Plant scope: alternators, radiators, transformers, controls
faq: What is the difference between the Wärtsilä 34SG and the Jenbacher J620?
The 34SG is a medium speed gas engine with higher output per unit; the J620 is a high speed gas engine. See Wärtsilä 34SG vs Jenbacher J620 for manufacturer data side by side.

man-32-40-for-sale.intro: The MAN 32/40 is a four stroke medium speed engine for diesel and heavy fuel oil. The designation refers to cylinder bore and stroke. It is used in power plants and in ship propulsion.
uses: Power for islands and remote grids
man-32-40-for-sale.diff: The 32/40 is a medium speed engine for liquid fuels, unlike the gas engines Wärtsilä 34SG and Caterpillar G20CM34. Engines of this line were also built under licence, for example by STX.
checks: Fuel the engine runs on: diesel or HFO, and the fuel treatment plant included
Licence builder and year
Hours since major overhaul
faq: Can a MAN 32/40 run on heavy fuel oil?
The 32/40 line is designed for diesel and heavy fuel oil. HFO operation needs a fuel treatment system, which should be part of the scope.

mtu-16v4000-for-sale.intro: The MTU 16V4000 is a high speed diesel engine with 16 cylinders from the MTU Series 4000. It is used for standby and prime power, in mining and in rail and marine applications.
uses: Standby power for data centres and hospitals
mtu-16v4000-for-sale.diff: In the same class buyers usually compare the MTU 16V4000 with the Caterpillar 3516 and the Cummins QSK60. Series 4000 engines exist in several generations, for example G23 or G63.
checks: Engine generation and rating (standby, prime, continuous)
Container scope and alternator
Hours and maintenance records
faq: What does G63 mean on an MTU 16V4000?
The G code marks the generation and application of the Series 4000 engine. The data sheet of each unit states the exact code and rating.

jenbacher-j620-for-sale.intro: The Jenbacher J620 is a high speed gas engine with 20 cylinders from the Type 6 range of INNIO Jenbacher. It is used in combined heat and power plants, greenhouses and industrial power.
uses: Combined heat and power for industry and district heating
Greenhouse power, heat and CO2 supply
jenbacher-j620-for-sale.diff: The J620 is a high speed engine; medium speed engines such as the Wärtsilä 34SG and Caterpillar G20CM34 have a higher output per unit.
checks: Engine version and gas type (natural gas or special gases)
Hours since major overhaul
Heat recovery scope
faq: Are used Jenbacher J620 units available?
Used J620 units come to the market from CHP plants that are upgraded or closed. We search the market on request.

cummins-generator-sets-for-sale.intro: Cummins builds gas and diesel generator sets over a wide output range. Common engines in the used market are the KTA50 and QSK60 diesel engines and the C2000 N6CB gas generator set.
cummins-generator-sets-for-sale.diff: Cummins diesel generator sets compete with the Caterpillar 3516 and the MTU 16V4000. The C2000 N6CB is a gas generator set and is compared with other gas engines in its class.
checks: Engine model and fuel (diesel or gas)
Rating: standby or prime
New, unused or used, with hours
faq: What is the Cummins KTA50?
The KTA50 is a Cummins diesel engine used in generator sets for standby and prime power.
